usedFor: Timeneye tracks time, and “Create project” adds a project to book it against.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create project” in Timeneye
bestTemplate.why: Each new order gets its own project, so time can be tracked from day one.

watchOut: Automations run on an app event or a schedule, so check which one starts “Create project”.
